STANZA I
The Savior calls his people sheep
The Savior calls his people sheep,
And bids them on his love rely,
For he alone their souls can keep,
And he alone their wants supply.
No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Where Newton found it
Newton printed the hymn under Psalm 23:1. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. PSALM 23:1 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 23
JEHOVAH is our Shepherd’s name, Then what have we, though weak, to fear? Our sin and folly we proclaim, If we despond while he is near. STANZA III
